title_short: Mexico Lion · Like a Little Family
headline: Paola became a Lion because of her parents, and the club her mom founded has always been like a little family.
story: Paola Armendariz Alvarado is a Lion from Nuevo Laredo, Mexico. Her parents have been Lions for more than 20 years. Her mom founded her club: 20 members then, about 30 now. Since then they have been like a little family, going to meetings and celebrating each other's birthdays.
Friendship carries the cut (Hong Kong batch rule). The line about activities for the elderly is texture in the middle. The last thing we hear is the little-family line, never a service line.

Loops: L1 “Why did she become a Lion?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:04 (her parents). L2 “What does her club mean to her?” opens at 0:20 and closes on “each other's birthdays”. B-roll: moments of connection between Lions (laughing, hugging, helping), general enough that no shot suggests her club or another country.
do: Open on Paola with <q>Why did you become a Lion?</q> already on screen on frame 1.
Location pin <q>📍 Mexico</q> at 00:04–00:06, small, upper left.
Close on the little-family line, then the end card.
B-roll: Lions laughing, hugging, helping. From Lions' Dropbox folders Lions hands videos and Lions exhibit hall, and past Lions shoots: Skopje 2026-06-20, Saltash.
dont: Do not end on the service line (“giving their actions away or helping other people, I guess that's it”).
No “Hong Kong 2026 / 108th Lions International Convention” pill or any convention super.
Do not use the Spanish “single family” bite from IMG_8017.MOV: it is Maria, another Lion, and it ends on “We serve”.
No B-roll with a club banner, a flag or a country, and no wide convention crowds. Do not reuse the shot Atdhe rejected on 31 Oct (see his Frame.io note on V10).
No logo at the start, no self-intro, no name super.
